facts.claim: Weekly plans grew from 43.3% of app subscription revenue in 2023 to 55.5% in 2025, while monthly fell from 21.1% to 11.7% and annual from 29.2% to 22.5%
facts.source_title: Weekly vs monthly vs annual: which plan type should you offer?
facts.excerpt: Weekly plans generated 43.3% of app subscription revenue in 2023, rising to 55.5% by 2025; monthly dropped 21.1% to 11.7%, annual 29.2% to 22.5%.

facts.claim: Productivity apps take 76.7% of their subscriptions on monthly plans and 90.7% of their revenue from them
facts.source_title: Monthly subscriptions: when to offer them
facts.excerpt: In productivity, 76.7% of subscriptions are monthly but 90.7% of revenue comes from monthly plans.

facts.claim: Health and fitness is the only category where annual plans dominate revenue, at 60.6%, while utilities take 73.6% of revenue from weekly plans
facts.source_title: Weekly vs monthly vs annual: which plan type should you offer?
facts.excerpt: Health & Fitness is the only category where annual plans dominate at 60.6% of revenue; utilities generate 73.6% of revenue from weekly plans.

facts.claim: First-year retention on annual plans fell from 31% to 28% year on year

facts.excerpt: First-year annual retention fell from 31% to 28% year over year.
